_comment: Curated source for the home-page research table. Every DOI, version and Palomar id here must be a published public record. Run `python3 scripts/build_home.py --check` to compare against the live Zenodo and Palomar APIs before rebuilding.

areas.name: Spectral graph theory
areas.blurb: Localized eigenvalue bounds, forbidden subgraphs and exact counterexamples.

areas.name: Algorithms and complexity
areas.blurb: Exact reachable sets and fault detection in priority controllers.

areas.name: Weyl algebras
areas.blurb: The rank-one Dixmier conjecture under a bound on homogeneous mass.

areas.name: Collatz dynamics
areas.blurb: Quantitative almost-all theorems for the Collatz map in ordinary natural density.

areas.name: Path decompositions
areas.blurb: Cases of Gallai's conjecture that every connected graph on n vertices splits into at most ⌈n/2⌉ paths.

areas.name: Arithmetic graph spectra
areas.blurb: Adjacency spectra of graphs built from multiplication by primes.

works.title: A sharp asymptotic spectral bound for forbidden subgraphs
works.summary: For fixed F with chromatic number r+1 ≥ 3, every sufficiently large F-free graph satisfies F₂(A) ≤ 2(1−1/r)m − (2(1−1/r)−1)Δ(G) + εm. The graphs may be disconnected; a companion theorem identifies F₂ with the first two ordered eigenvalue squares in this range.

works.title: Connected counterexamples to the exact color-critical two-eigenvalue bound
works.summary: Joining K(s,s,s) to K₄ by one bridge gives connected (K₅ minus an edge)-free graphs with arbitrarily many edges whose first two ordered eigenvalue squares sum to more than 4m/3. This refutes KKP Conjecture 1.16 and Li–Liu–Zhang Conjecture 5.4.

works.title: Localized two-eigenvalue bound for finite noncomplete graphs
works.summary: For every finite noncomplete simple graph on at least two vertices, λ₁² + λ₂² ≤ Σₑ 2(1−1/c(e)), where c(e) is the largest clique containing edge e. The formalization uses the checked BN spectral lift, with attribution to its source.

works.title: Polynomial Fault Detection Without Bounded Width: Exact Reachable Sets in Priority Controllers
works.summary: An exact description of reachable eligible sets gives polynomial bridge-fault detection in generalized c432 priority controllers, including a family of linear treewidth. The paper also proves complexity and representation bounds; its fault-model extensions are outside the earlier Lean formalization.
works.formal_note: The manuscript describes an earlier Lean formalization. No Palomar entry is linked for this paper.

works.title: The rank-one Dixmier conjecture for elements of mass at most six
works.summary: Over any characteristic-zero field, P and Q in the first Weyl algebra with QP − PQ = 1 generate the algebra when P has at most six nonzero homogeneous components for deg X = 1 and deg Y = −1. No degree, order or mass bound is imposed on Q.

works.title: Polylogarithmic Descent for Almost All Collatz Orbits in Natural Density
works.summary: For any f(n) → ∞, almost every n in natural density reaches an iterate below (log n)^A_FP · f(n) after c* log n + O(√(log n log log n)) shortcut steps, with an explicit exponent A_FP ≈ 9.9911.

works.title: Quantitative Endpoint Transport for the Collatz Map with a Natural-Density Descent Application
works.summary: A reusable arbitrary-target endpoint-transport theorem, with exponent asymptotically linear in the input density exponent, giving natural-density descent to exp((log n)^(1−δ)) for every δ < 0.25124….

explainer.label: Interactive explainer
explainer.features: full HTML paper, orbit figures, theorem → Lean map

works.title: Positive density of Collatz convergence at every rate above 3/log(4/3)
works.summary: A positive proportion of integers reach 1 within c log x ordinary Collatz steps for every fixed c > 3/log(4/3), with one lower density bound independent of c.

works.title: Gallai's conjecture with two exceptional even vertices
works.summary: Extends the endpoint form of Gallai's conjecture to two designated even vertices that need not be adjacent, when every other even vertex has at most three even neighbours.

works.title: Gallai's Path Decomposition Conjecture for Graphs with Small Bowtie Boundaries
works.summary: Graphs whose even-degree subgraph has a whole-bowtie component with at most four external neighbours admit ⌈|V|/2⌉ path decompositions; a computer-assisted proof with finite reconstruction certificates.

works.title: Prime-Star Localization and Second-Order Spectra of Finite Divisibility Cover Graphs
works.summary: For the graph joining n to np on [1, X], the top adjacency eigenvalue satisfies λ₁² = π(X) + 4 Σ_{p≤X} 1/(p−1) + o(1), via a large-prime star forest whose first-order perturbation vanishes.

works.title: Prescribed Eigenvalues in Power Bands of Finite Prime-Cover Graphs
works.summary: Prescribed-rank eigenvalue estimates in growing power bands, including an every-centre paper theorem for 21/61 < θ < 1/2. The Palomar formalization covers selected density-one estimates for 0 < θ < 1/2.
